The likely cause is the Zustand member view. It fetches data using the correct share ID, but both store copies keep one global array for members and one each for internal and external invitations. Opening another share replaces those arrays, while the view reads them without a share filter. The affected files are the [invitation store](/app/packages/drive-store/zustand/share/invitations.store.ts), [member store](/app/packages/drive-store/zustand/share/members.store.ts), [store types](/app/packages/drive-store/zustand/share/types.ts), and [member view](/app/packages/drive-store/store/_views/useShareMemberViewZustand.tsx), with matching copies under `applications/drive/src/app`.

A fix should key each array by `shareId`, return `[]` for an unset share, and pass the resolved share ID through every set, remove, update, and add path. It should also add the requested `getExistingEmails` utility over the three arrays for the selected share. I found no existing tests for these stores or this view, so the diagnosis is based on code inspection. Project source and tests remain unchanged under this specialist run’s instructions.
